method: One warm-up; rotated six variants. reference/control freeze the 0.22.0 builder; current/current_control use ordinary production parsing. counters/timed observe that same production builder above its arena; timed adds per-operation clocks. Logical operations are exclusive: recursive child parsing is outside append/object intervals. Indexed insertion includes hashing, duplicate lookup and any growth. EOF/depth/owner work is outside operation buckets. Narrow timings include instrumentation and are not an additive uninstrumented CPU budget; full-parser controls govern acceptance. Observed timing excludes arena-owner setup; ordinary timing includes it. Output checks and cleanup are outside timers. Backing allocation counts include the owner/scanner and must reach zero; logical arena requests are bulk reclaimed. No production clocks or counters.
